before.requirement: When compiling an XPath expression that references a defined variable, pass a populated xpath_variable_set to the query constructor so the reference can compile.
before.reason: The constructor accepts a variable set, while the parser rejects a variable reference if no set is provided. The old harness calls the constructor with only the query text.

after.requirement: When compiling an XPath expression that references a defined variable, pass a populated xpath_variable_set to the query constructor so the reference can compile.
after.reason: The constructor argument and variable-reference requirement remain present. The depth check does not supply the variable set omitted by the old harness.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same one-argument constructor call uses the null default for the variable-set argument. The complete harness has no equivalent setup or call sequence.
